mapper.select: SELECT P2.PROJECT_ID AS projectId, P2.PROJECT_NAME AS parentProjectName, P2.END_DATE AS endDate, P2.PM_USER_ID AS pmUserId, P2.PL_USER_ID AS plUserId, ROUND(AVG(NVL(T.PROGRESS_RATE, 0)), 0) AS progressRate FROM PROJECTS P2 LEFT JOIN PROJECTS P ON P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = P2.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN TASKS T ON P.PROJECT_ID = T.PROJECT_ID WHERE P2.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY P2.PROJECT_ID, P2.PROJECT_NAME, P2.END_DATE, P2.PM_USER_ID, P2.PL_USER_ID ORDER BY P2.PROJECT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROJECTS ( PROJECT_ID, PARENT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, PM_USER_ID, PL_USER_ID, EDITOR_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{parentProjectId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{isPublic}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{pmUserId}, #{plUserId}, #{editorUserId} )
